title: Plants & How They Grow
subject: Integrated Studies
description: Seeds, sunlight, and the amazing life of plants!

video.title: Everything You Need To Know About Plants

steps: Plants need 4 things to grow: sunlight, water, air, and soil.
A plant starts as a tiny SEED. It sprouts roots down and a stem up!
Plant parts have jobs: ROOTS drink water, the STEM carries it up, LEAVES make food from sunlight, FLOWERS make seeds.
Plants give US food and fresh air — Jamaica's mango, ackee, and banana trees all started as seeds!

questions.prompt: What do plants need to grow? Pick ALL!
questions.hint: Four needs: sun, water, air, soil.

questions.prompt: What does a plant start as?
Which part of the plant drinks water from the soil?
questions.hint: They grow DOWN into the soil.

questions.prompt: Which part makes food using sunlight?
